fc369306-444a-4206-8219-d8c9f6c6d30c/Eve.en: Between the stone crevices, a spring of spiritual Spring Water flows quietly,<NL>the Spring Water is clear as Glaze, spiritual Qi rises from the water's surface,<NL>warmth spreads along the moisture, dispelling the surrounding chill,<NL>soaking in this spring can ease the pain of body forging and heal Injuries......
fc369306-444a-4206-8219-d8c9f6c6d30c/Eve.cn: 石隙之间，一汪灵泉静静淌动，<NL>泉水清透如琉璃，灵气自水面升起，<NL>暖意顺着水汽漫溢，驱散周遭寒意，<NL>浸此泉可缓锻体之痛并恢复伤势……

58b44654-77e3-4c44-8855-9bf7c32d8b3d/Eve.en: Ahead, the stone platform glows with spiritual light, an ancient Mechanism stands silently,<NL>as soon as approached, a voice sounds out of nowhere:<NL>"This is the inheritance Mechanism,<NL>show it the fruits of your hard training, and only with its approval can you pass Unharmed……"
58b44654-77e3-4c44-8855-9bf7c32d8b3d/Eve.cn: 前方石台灵光流转，古朴机关静静矗立，<NL>甫一接近，一道声音凭空响起：<NL>“此乃传承机关，<NL>向其展示尔苦练之功，得认可方可无恙通行……”
58b44654-77e3-4c44-8855-9bf7c32d8b3d/Eve.ru: Впереди каменная платформа светится духовным светом, безмолвно стоит древний механизм,<NL>как только мы приближаемся, из ниоткуда раздается голос:<NL>"Это механизм наследования,<NL>покажи ему плоды своих упорных тренировок, и только с его одобрения ты сможешь пройти невредимым......"

09462c01-9d7f-4228-b621-ee32af7a5087/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> the moment he steps into this domain, the surrounding air suddenly becomes solemn,<NL>in the distance on a high platform, Cloud Mist shrouds, a voice slowly descends, piercing the mind:<NL>"This is the inheritance ground of the Volatile Loong Depiction, to seek the secret tome, you must first temper your Physique a hundred times and train your Willpower,<NL>after going through many ordeals and trials, only then are you qualified to explore its true form……"
09462c01-9d7f-4228-b621-ee32af7a5087/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>甫一踏入这片地界，周身空气便骤然一肃，<NL>远处高台之上，云雾缭绕，一道声音缓缓降下，直透心神：<NL>“此乃象龙演画传承之地，欲寻奇书，必先百炼筋骨、苦练意志，<NL>历经重重历练考验，方有资格一探真容……”

5f0c8582-7e2f-40f2-924f-407111400a79/Eve.en: Mechanism rune suddenly lights up, golden light flows within the patterns:<NL>"Trial passed, continue forward……"
5f0c8582-7e2f-40f2-924f-407111400a79/Eve.cn: 机关符文骤然亮起，纹路间流转金光：<NL>"考验通过，继续前行……"
5f0c8582-7e2f-40f2-924f-407111400a79/Eve.ru: Руна механизма внезапно загорается, золотистый свет струится по узорам:<NL>"Испытание пройдено, продолжайте двигаться вперед......"

9b75c762-872b-4051-a167-961601dbd068/Eve.en: The light of the mechanism disappears, and the patterns are dim and cold...<NL>A cold voice judges with certainty,<NL>"Not seasoned enough. Not qualified for the legacy."
9b75c762-872b-4051-a167-961601dbd068/Eve.cn: 机关光芒骤敛，石纹灰光冷冽……<NL>漠然的声响不容置疑地评判道：<NL>“火候不足，不堪传承。”
9b75c762-872b-4051-a167-961601dbd068/Eve.ru: Свет механизма исчезает, а узоры становятся тусклыми и холодными...<NL>Холодный голос судит с уверенностью,<NL>- Недостаточно закаленный. Не подходит для наследования."

6d40429a-38dd-44f8-9f43-4cecb492f19f/Eve.en: A milky white spring lies in the cavern.<NL>The Ten-Millennia Stalactite Milk is just ahead.<NL>A dip in it makes your body soar and inflicts external injuries.<NL>It enhances one's physique...
6d40429a-38dd-44f8-9f43-4cecb492f19f/Eve.cn: 一汪莹白乳泉静静卧于石穴之中，<NL>面前乃是万年钟乳，<NL>浸之筋骨酸痛，以致外伤，<NL>有强筋健骨之效…
6d40429a-38dd-44f8-9f43-4cecb492f19f/Eve.ru: В пещере находится молочно-белый источник.<NL>Десятитысячелетнее Сталактитовое молоко только впереди.<NL>Погружение в него заставляет ваше тело парить и наносит внешние повреждения.<NL>Это улучшает физическое состояние человека...

7321c1bc-f6d2-4ab3-8851-83f5f3d27079/Eve.en: In the depth of the cavern, a spring boils.<NL>The air blowing over makes one's bones chill.<NL>The Stoneheart Poison Marrow is just ahead.<NL>A dip in it inflicts irritation all over and internal injuries.<NL>It forges one's willpower...

Clouds float beneath the mountain tops.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> stops advancing and enjoys the view, watching the constantly changing world...
3def9ca9-de33-418f-959e-be846853fac0/Eve.cn: 怀揣奇书《象龙演画》，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>一步步行出此地……<NL>山风拂面，天光豁然开阔，<NL>天地辽阔无边，云海奔涌在群山之间，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>驻足远眺，望着苍茫世间……

f150ef75-0bf1-405c-8e67-b3af528a02da/Eve.en: Harboring empty thoughts of the remnant scroll, with not a shred of Opportunity upon him,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> silently steps away from this Secret Realm……<NL>Cold wind seeps into his clothes, gloomy dusk presses down upon the mountains,<NL>Opportunity has not been granted, the road ahead still requires step-by-step seeking……
f150ef75-0bf1-405c-8e67-b3af528a02da/Eve.cn: 怀揣残卷空念，无半分机缘加身，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>默然举步离了此方秘境……<NL>冷风浸衣，暮色沉沉压落群山，<NL>机缘未济，前路仍需步步求索……

76698635-2b7e-4862-a690-8261f64a54bb/Eve.en: The stone platform's spiritual light trembles, the Mystic Armor Guardian steps forward, his oppressive aura fiercely pressing down.<NL>"I have guarded this book for a thousand years; though you passed the Trial, if you do not earn my approval, don't think to take even a fraction of the inheritance!"<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s expression remains unmoved, he replies solemnly: "I have tempered my Physique a hundred times and honed my mind; I am naturally worthy of this Opportunity."<NL>The Guardian's gaze narrows, he says in a deep voice: "Worthy or not, after we exchange blows, the answer will be clear."
76698635-2b7e-4862-a690-8261f64a54bb/Eve.cn: 石台灵光一震，玄甲守护者踏步现身，威压凛冽压来。<NL>“吾守此书千年，试炼虽过，不得我意，休想取走半分传承！”<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>神色不动，凛然应声：“我百炼筋骨、苦砺心神，自当配得上这份机缘。”<NL>守护者眸光一敛，沉声道：“配与不配，交手之后，自有分辨。”

1c4ce411-b2d6-4cb6-a8df-07010bbeeba6/Eve.en: The fight is over. The guardian is convinced. The will to fight is gone.<NL>"Your moves are open and upright, and your heart is pure. You are far better than the others who came before.<NL>After tens of thousands of years, I'm tired of guarding this place alone.<NL>Since you beat me, I shall call an end to my duty and travel with you."
1c4ce411-b2d6-4cb6-a8df-07010bbeeba6/Eve.cn: 交手落幕，守护者心悦诚服，战意尽数收敛。<NL>“你招式中正，道心纯粹，远超寻常求缘之人。<NL>我守此秘境万年，早已倦于孤守。<NL>既败给于你，便自此放下镇守之任，随你同行，共赴前路。”

707aaa2d-16db-41d9-98ea-c4bba403d658/Eve.en: With the smoke of battle clearing, the Guardian retreats step by step, all his oppressive aura dissipated.<NL>He looks at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, his tone deep and slow: "Your cultivation is powerful, your techniques sharp; I am not unjustly defeated.<NL>You have passed all the Trials, and broken my guarding battle; you are now qualified to wield the Volatile Loong Depiction."<NL>With that, he raises his hand to remove the last barrier, the stone platform bursts with golden light, thus fulfilling his duty as guardian.
707aaa2d-16db-41d9-98ea-c4bba403d658/Eve.cn: 硝烟散尽，守护者节节败退，一身威压尽数消散。<NL>他望着 <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，语气沉缓：“你修为强横，手段凌厉，我败得不冤。<NL>你闯尽试炼，又破我守关之战，已然拥有执掌《象龙演画》的资格。”<NL>说罢抬手撤去最后一层禁制，石台金光大放，就此卸下镇守之责。

56b34fba-fb4b-4b16-982b-666713679e89/Eve.en: After losing the fight, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s breath grows chaotic, and cannot keep up.<NL>The guardian stops giving off pressure. Solemn and distant, he speaks, "You may have survived the trials, but you are not strong enough from the core, and you lack strength."<NL>"Your power is not enough to support your ambition. You don't deserve the legacy of the Volatile Loong."<NL>Then, the mechanism's glow fades away. The secret tome remains heavily guarded by restrictions, leaving <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> no choice but to leave the realm and grow stronger before returning to claim it.
56b34fba-fb4b-4b16-982b-666713679e89/Eve.cn: 交手落败，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> 气息紊乱，无力再战。<NL>守护者收回威压，神色冷淡肃穆：“你虽熬过试炼，可武道根基浅薄，实力尚且不足。”<NL>“心有余而力未及，尚且不配执掌象龙传承。”<NL>话音落下，机关灵光隐去，奇书禁制重锁，只得黯然退离秘境，静待来日修行再来。

f51a4612-89aa-4c35-84b8-801131e4659f/Eve.en: Moves retract, force dissipates. The formidable one of this age, after receiving several blows, crashes down, devoid of life.<NL>The powerful oppressive aura within the arena suddenly dissolves, the Trial barrier breaks apart with a sound, and the path ahead opens wide.
f51a4612-89aa-4c35-84b8-801131e4659f/Eve.cn: 招势收沉，劲气散尽。当世强者受尽数记冲击，轰然颓倒，再无生机。<NL>场内强横威压骤然消融，试炼壁垒应声瓦解，前路豁然敞开。
